description: Source code for the Goteo project's administrative sub-controller class 'ProjectsSubController'. This class manages various project-related administrative actions such as configuration, assigning consultants, rebase, reporting, image management, location setting, date adjustments, state transitions (publish, enable, cancel, fulfill, reject), and listing projects within the admin panel.

classes.name: ProjectsSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing admin actions for projects, including configuration, assignment, state changes, and list retrieval.

methods.name: confAction
methods.description: Handles project configuration updates, including campaign days and campaign rounds.

methods.name: consultantsAction
methods.description: Manages assignment or unassignment of consultants to a project.

methods.name: rebaseAction
methods.description: Allows reassigning a new ID to a project, with checks to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: reportAction
methods.description: Generates and returns data for project's financial report.

methods.name: open_tagsAction
methods.description: Manages open tags for a project, assigning or unassigning tags.

methods.name: assignAction
methods.description: Assigns a project to a call in a campaign.

methods.name: moveAction
methods.description: Moves a project to a different node.

methods.name: imagesAction
methods.description: Manages project images and their sections.

methods.name: accountsAction
methods.description: Updates project financial accounts details.

methods.name: locationAction
methods.description: Sets or updates the geographical location of a project.

methods.name: datesAction
methods.description: Modifies various date fields associated with a project.

methods.name: reviewAction
methods.description: Transitions a project to review state.

methods.name: publishAction
methods.description: Publishes a project, making it publicly visible.

methods.name: enableAction
methods.description: Sets project status to 'enabled' or 'in editing'.

methods.name: cancelAction
methods.description: Marks a project as canceled or discarded.

methods.name: fulfillAction
methods.description: Marks a project as having satisfied the return conditions.

methods.name: unfulfillAction
methods.description: Marks a project as funded or in progress manually.

methods.name: rejectAction
methods.description: Rejects a project, sending a notification email to the owner.

methods.name: derivationAction
methods.description: Handles project rejection with platform furthest communication.

methods.name: noinvestAction
methods.description: Closes the investment flow for a project.

methods.name: openinvestAction
methods.description: Reopens the investment flow for a project.

methods.name: watchAction
methods.description: Starts monitoring a project.

methods.name: unwatchAction
methods.description: Stops monitoring a project.

methods.name: finishAction
methods.description: Ends the campaign for the project.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of projects based on filters.

methods.name: doFeed
methods.description: Creates feed entries for project actions to log activity.
